_comment: S1 collection policy — the SINGLE source of truth for per-signal cadence + scheduling. collector.py reads this at startup; reconcile() re-syncs live tasks to it every 5 min, so editing here changes cadence with no code change. interval_sec = seconds between polls.

quote.note: live session-aware price; LIVE-only, highest priority

bars.note: OHLCV incl. volume (daily EOD on the basic plan; hourly when available)

short.note: short interest; upstream is bi-monthly, polled hourly to catch a new print fast (handler dedups)

statements.note: fundamentals; upstream is quarterly, polled hourly to catch a new filing fast (handler dedups)

transcript.note: earnings-call transcripts (PAID, blocked until key set)
